function_v0.doc: Returns all registry quote inputs from one branch invocation. Besides\nreducing Soroban Wasm-instantiation cost, this prevents the registry\nfrom mixing values read at different points in the invocation.
function_v0.name: redemption_state

function_v0.doc:
Irreversibly shuts the branch down after the registered price feed
has detected terminal failure under its configured source policy. Unlike
`shutdown`, this path intentionally has no collateral-ratio
check because a trustworthy current price is unavailable.
`last_good_price` is supplied by the authenticated price feed because a
callback into that price feed would be forbidden Soroban re-entry.

Repeated callbacks return the original shutdown timestamp instead of
reverting. This lets an independent price-feed failure-report invocation
land harmlessly if another invocation already shut down the branch.
function_v0.name: shutdown_from_price_feed_failure
